name: William Creek
objection: Tiny settlement, mainly a pub and airstrip; the visit is a meal and a photo

name: Mungerannie
objection: It is a roadhouse and accommodation business and the source gives little to see

name: Oodnadatta Track
objection: A long linear feature, its stops are already separate candidates, and a pin on a line is arbitrary

name: Strzelecki Track
objection: Equivalent to the Oodnadatta Track as a named outback route; against: remote, gravel and mostly a transit road

name: Painted Desert (South Australia)
objection: Real scenic draw; against: one passing mention, rough access, usually seen via tours or flights

name: Faye's Underground Home
objection: Small family attraction; one counted source

name: Old Timers Mine
objection: Wikivoyage link is marked dead; only one source

name: Tom's Working Opal Mine
objection: It is a tour operator listing; for: a distinct working mine visit

name: Big Winch
objection: Short stop

name: Umoona Opal Mine and Museum
objection: Commercial business with accommodation; source is a region page

name: Saint Elijah the Prophet Serbian Orthodox Church
objection: Active church, may be restricted by services

name: Catholic Catacomb Church
objection: For: underground interior a guide mentions; against: lesser than the Serbian church

name: Dingo Fence at Coober Pedy
objection: For: iconic structure; against: a fence beside a road, 10 minute stop

name: Moon Plain
objection: For: second-tier icon; against: a plain visited from a road, mostly seen by tour

name: Woomera Missile Park
objection: Short stop of about 30 minutes

name: Woomera Heritage Centre
objection: Small museum; the History Museum next door may be a near duplicate

name: Roxby Downs Arid Recovery Reserve
objection: For: unique wildlife; against: access by tour only

name: Lake Torrens National Park
objection: For: a national park; against: remote and mostly inaccessible

name: Lake Gairdner National Park
objection: Access is hard to find, station-crossing and 4WD

name: Lake Hart
objection: Short roadside stop and sparse description

name: Marree Mosque
objection: Only a replica, short stop, mud-brick ruins

name: Lake Eyre South
objection: For: easy roadside look at the lake; against: usually a dry salt flat and part of the larger lake

name: Curdimurka Siding
objection: Ruins and a sign, 20-minute stop

name: The Bubbler and Blanche Cup
objection: Overlaps Wabma Kadarbu Mound Springs Conservation Park

name: Coward Springs
objection: Mostly a campground; only one counted source and the Wabma Kadarbu mound springs nearby may be the real draw.

name: William Creek Hotel
objection: For: famed remote-outback icon visitors photograph and stop at. Against: a pub/accommodation; William Creek town is the place and should carry it.

name: Algebuckina Bridge
objection: One counted source, a short stop, and the Wikivoyage mention is a single clause.

name: Pink Roadhouse
objection: It is a roadhouse/shop and fuel stop, which the business rule would reject; the case rests on its being a recognised landmark.

name: Railway Tjukurpa Museum
objection: One counted source and a small-town museum with a short visit.

name: Munga-Thirri–Simpson Desert National Park
objection: Very remote and permit-gated; many visitors will never enter, and it can be reached only by experienced 4WD travellers.

name: Witjira National Park
objection: Remote and Desert Parks Pass required; Dalhousie Springs might be listed as its own spot, making the park a wrapper.

name: Malkumba–Coongie Lakes National Park
objection: About 100 km of 4WD tracks, access often impossible when wet or dry; few visitors in practice.

name: Innamincka Regional Reserve
objection: For: the park-managed reserve is where visitors camp, fish and cruise. Against: a reserve boundary, its attractions listed separately.

name: Cullyamurra Waterhole
objection: One counted source; remote and water-level dependent.

name: Innamincka Town Sunset Lookout
objection: For: named in the town's See list. Against: a short viewpoint with no description, one source.

name: Cooper Creek Crossing
objection: For: named Do item, free, easy, wildlife. Against: one source, a causeway within walking distance of the town.

name: Kalamurina Sanctuary
objection: For: significant wildlife sanctuary at the Warburton/Lake Eyre inflow. Against: booking-only, tours, operator source only, access depends on road conditions.

name: Elizabeth Symon Nursing Home
objection: For: heritage-register building and the place to find rangers. Against: now a park office, one source, no stated public access.
